size/S.description: One service, about 5 files or fewer

size/M.description: One or two services, no schema or contract change

size/L.description: Schema change or a change to how Python and Java talk

size/XL.description: Epic: split into smaller issues before building

area/cross-service.description: Touches the Java hold service or its contract with Python

touches-schema.description: Changes models.py or the database schema

issues.close_comment: Closing as part of the backlog cleanup. The boarding pass on My Bookings now covers most of this, and a `GET /bookings/{id}` route would collide with the existing `GET /bookings/{user_id}`. The remaining parts live in #34 and #44.
Closing as part of the backlog cleanup. Passenger details would have to travel through the Java quote and hold, which this issue did not account for. Group booking (#28) no longer depends on it.

Closing: destination pages shipped with PR #73 and are linked from the homepage, the flight board and the solar map.

Closing as part of the backlog cleanup. A discount applied to the quote is lost today, because the backend recomputes the price when the hold is confirmed. Worth reopening after #151.

issues.title: Refund preview on cancel
issues.trap: Departure times come in two formats: test fixtures use `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`, seed data uses ISO 8601 with a `Z`. A single strptime pattern passes the tests and fails on real data.
